name: Dried Seeds
summary: At the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem gives travelers Dried Seeds to test the life-giving power beneath the Barrens' waters.

sections.title: The Seeds and the Oasis
sections.body: Tonga Runetotem studies the strange vents beneath the Barrens' waters. At the Forgotten Pools, he found fissures below the surface and now wants to learn whether one lies beneath the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. He gives travelers Dried Seeds, which appear lifeless, to place in the bubbling fissure. Their response can show whether the energy beneath the oases can stir life in dead seeds.

faq.q: What are the Dried Seeds used for?
aliases: what do i do with dried seeds
faq.answer: You use Dried Seeds to test the bubbling fissure beneath the Stagnant Oasis. Place them in its waters and see whether the energy there can revive them.

aliases: where do dried seeds come from
faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem, a tauren druid at the Crossroads, gives travelers the Dried Seeds. He studies the Barrens' sudden bursts of plant growth.

faq.q: Where is the fissure to use them on?
faq.answer: The fissure lies beneath the waters of the Stagnant Oasis, southeast of the Crossroads in the Barrens.

faq.q: What happens when the seeds are exposed to the fissure?
faq.answer: Tonga asks you to place the dead seeds in the bubbling fissure and observe them. Their response reveals the result of his experiment.

angles.text: As a druid, you can use the dead seeds to study the strange energies rising from the Barrens' earth.
As a Horde adventurer, you can help Tonga Runetotem investigate the changes in the Barrens' dry soils.
